description.zh: 按日期记录组会：标题、汇报要点、讨论反馈、未决问题与材料链接。列表可搜索、按活跃、归档与回收站切换，详情直接编辑并在输入时自动存草稿；保存失败保留输入，修订冲突可以载入最新记录。
description.en: Group meetings by date: title, brief, discussion feedback, open questions and material links. The list searches and switches between active, archived and trash; the detail edits in place, keeps a draft while you type, keeps your input when saving fails, and offers the latest record on a revision conflict.

emptyActive.zh: 还没有组会记录；点「新建」写下第一次讨论。
emptyActive.en: No meetings yet; use New to write down the first discussion.

emptyTrash.zh: 回收站是空的。移入回收站的记录三十天后自动清除。
emptyTrash.en: The trash is empty. Trashed records are cleared after thirty days.

truncated.zh: 只列出最近 {n} 条，共 {total} 条；用搜索找更早的记录。
truncated.en: Showing the latest {n} of {total}; search for older records.

quotaWarning.zh: 记录已用到 {percent}%，先整理归档或回收站。
quotaWarning.en: Records use {percent}% of the limit; tidy the archive or trash.

materialInvalid.zh: 材料地址只收 http/https 的完整地址。
materialInvalid.en: Material links must be complete http/https addresses.

draftRestored.zh: 已恢复上次未保存的内容。

unsavedClose.zh: 还有没保存的修改；关闭后草稿会保留。
unsavedClose.en: There are unsaved changes; closing keeps the draft.

conflict.zh: 这条记录在别处更新过，保存被拒绝。可以载入最新的内容，或继续用你的编辑。
conflict.en: This record changed elsewhere and the save was rejected. Load the latest content, or continue with your edits.

loadLatest.zh: 载入最新（放弃本地修改）

trashRestoreHint.zh: 回收站里的记录三十天后自动清除；先恢复再编辑。
trashRestoreHint.en: Trashed records are cleared after thirty days; restore before editing.
